output:
Short answer: consider the Meadowlight Lamp as a leading candidate for an energy‑efficient office desk-lamp upgrade.

Why I recommend it (evidence from saved memory)
- The facilities guide lists the Meadowlight Lamp as an energy-efficient task light for office desks.
- The workplace catalog describes the Meadowlight Lamp as a certified low-energy product for focused desk work.
- The catalog also says it is independently certified for exceptional energy efficiency and recommends it for sustainable office upgrades.
- Facilities teams in your org prefer adjustable task lamps and review product certifications before purchase (so Meadowlight fits the stated procurement practice).

What in those claims still needs verification (I recommend confirming these before purchase)
- Exact certification(s): the catalog says “certified” and “independently certified” but does not name the program(s). Verify which label(s) apply (e.g., ENERGY STAR, DLC, TCO, EU ecolabel) and view the certifying documentation.
- Measured performance: confirm rated lumen output, wattage, and luminous efficacy (lm/W). The catalog claim of “exceptional energy efficiency” needs a numeric basis.
- Light quality and suitability: confirm color temperature (K), CRI (color rendering index), dimming capability and range, flicker specs, and beam/optics for desk work.
- Lifetime and maintenance: verify rated LED lifetime (L70 or Lx), warranty length and terms, and replacement-part policy.
- Price, availability and procurement terms: verify current unit cost, bulk discounts, lead times, and return policy.
- Compliance and safety: verify any electrical safety and EMC certifications required by your facilities (e.g., UL/CE, local approvals).
- Any catalog recommendations that relate to sustainability (e.g., recycled materials, take‑back) — confirm specifics if those matter.

Practical evaluation checklist (what to request/test)
- Product spec sheet and certification documents
- Measured lumens, wattage, and lm/W
- Color temperature and CRI
- Dimming type (triac, 0–10 V, PWM) and compatibility with controls
- Glare control/adjustability and articulation range
- L70 lifetime and warranty
- Sample unit to test on typical desks (task illuminance in lux)
- Price, quantity discounts, lead time, and service terms

Would you like me to:
- Pull the Meadowlight spec sheet and certification details from the catalog/memory (if available), or
- Create a short RFQ/specification you can send to vendors, or
- Compare Meadowlight to other energy‑efficient desk lamps (I can search for additional candidates)?

Tell me which next step you prefer and I’ll proceed.
